---
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
params:
  results: NULL
  title: "crossRanger analysis report"
  top_n: 20
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)
results <- params$results
top_n <- params$top_n
show_table <- function(df, caption = NULL) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  num <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))
  df[num] <- lapply(df[num], signif, digits = 3)
  cat("\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(df, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
}
show_plot <- function(p) {
  if (inherits(p, "gtable") || inherits(p, "grob")) {
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(p)
  } else {
    print(p)
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
top_features <- function(fi) {
  cols <- intersect(c("feature", "rf_imps", "mean_logfc", "non.param.test_p.adj", "Enr"), colnames(fi))
  utils::head(fi[order(-fi$rf_imps), cols], top_n)
}
pkg_version <- tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion("crossRanger")), error = function(e) "development version")
```

This report was generated by crossRanger (`r pkg_version`) with `r R.version.string`.
It summarizes `r length(results)` analysis result(s).

```{r report, results='asis'}
for (nm in names(results)) {
  res <- results[[nm]]
  cat("\n\n# ", gsub("_", " ", nm), "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (inherits(res, "rf_clf.by_datasets") || inherits(res, "rf_clf.comps")) {
    cat("## Within-study classification performance\n\n")
    show_table(res$perf_summ)
    show_plot(crossRanger::plot_clf_ROC(res))
    cat("## Top features by random forest importance\n\n")
    for (ds in names(res$feature_imps_list)) show_table(top_features(res$feature_imps_list[[ds]]), caption = ds)
  } else if (inherits(res, "rf_reg.by_datasets")) {
    cat("## Within-study regression performance\n\n")
    show_table(res$perf_summ)
    show_plot(crossRanger::plot_reg_res_list(res)$summ_plot)
    cat("## Top features by random forest importance\n\n")
    for (ds in names(res$feature_imps_list)) {
      imps <- sort(res$feature_imps_list[[ds]], decreasing = TRUE)
      show_table(utils::head(data.frame(feature = names(imps), rf_imps = imps), top_n), caption = ds)
    }
  } else if (inherits(res, "rf_clf.by_datasets.summ") || inherits(res, "rf_clf.comps.summ")) {
    cat("## Within-study classification performance\n\n")
    show_table(res$perf_summ)
    show_plot(res$summ_plot)
    show_plot(res$feature_res_plot)
    if (!is.null(res$res_list)) show_plot(crossRanger::plot_clf_ROC(res$res_list))
  } else if (inherits(res, c("rf_clf.cross_appl", "rf_reg.cross_appl", "rf_clf.lodo", "rf_reg.lodo"))) {
    cat("## Performance of cross-dataset predictions\n\n")
    cols <- intersect(c("Train_data", "Test_data", "Validation_type", "Accuracy", "AUROC", "AUPRC", "Kappa", "F1",
                        "MAE", "RMSE", "R_squared", "Spearman_rho"), colnames(res$perf_summ))
    show_table(res$perf_summ[!is.na(res$perf_summ$Train_data), cols])
    if (!is.null(res$perf_mean)) show_table(as.data.frame(t(res$perf_mean)), caption = "Mean performance over held-out datasets")
    show_plot(crossRanger::plot_cross_appl(res))
  } else if (inherits(res, c("rf_clf.rfe", "rf_reg.rfe"))) {
    cat("## Recursive feature elimination\n\n")
    show_table(res$top_n_perf)
    fs <- if (inherits(res, "rf_clf.rfe")) crossRanger::plot_clf_feature_selection(res) else crossRanger::plot_reg_feature_selection(res)
    show_plot(fs$plot)
    cat("Optimal number of features: **", res$optimal_n_features, "**\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("Selected features: ", paste(res$selected_features, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
  } else if (is.list(res) && !is.null(res$corr_mat)) {
    cat("## Correlation of feature importance between datasets\n\n")
    show_table(data.frame(Dataset = rownames(res$corr_mat), res$corr_mat, check.names = FALSE))
    if (!is.null(res$feature_consistency)) show_table(utils::head(res$feature_consistency, top_n), caption = "Consistency of top-ranked features")
  } else if (is.data.frame(res) && all(c("non.param.test_p.adj", "Enr") %in% colnames(res))) {
    cat("## Significantly differential features\n\n")
    sig <- res[!is.na(res$Enr) & res$Enr != "Neutral", , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(sig) == 0) {
      cat("No feature is significant.\n\n")
    } else {
      cols <- intersect(c("mean_logfc", "non.param.test_p", "non.param.test_p.adj", "Enr"), colnames(sig))
      sig <- data.frame(feature = rownames(sig), sig[, cols, drop = FALSE])
      show_table(utils::head(sig[order(sig$non.param.test_p.adj), ], 100))
    }
  } else if (inherits(res, "ggplot")) {
    show_plot(res)
  } else if (is.data.frame(res)) {
    show_table(utils::head(res, 100))
  } else {
    cat("```\n")
    utils::str(res, max.level = 1)
    cat("```\n\n")
  }
}
```
